posts.title: Adding site search to static sites using Zilliz Cloud
posts.description: A guide to building hybrid site search for a static site with 11ty, GitHub Actions, Cloudflare Workers and Zilliz Cloud. Typeahead, BM25 and vector search on free tiers, with no servers to look after.
